thread:
nora: opened thread for parity-check on v7-int4 bringup. rolled 1% at 02:05 UTC. obvious tail latency wins, but parity metrics for legal-doc slice look off.
kevin: saw it. P95 -32% which is great, but Legal-F1 proxy is down -5.6% on the 3k+ token slice. global parity -0.7%.
sasha: auto-eval shows explanatory hallucination up +3.0% abs on that slice (2.0% -> 5.0%). samples in s3://redwood-evals/1742103333/v7-int4/legal-diffs.txt — some citations are dropped in mid-document summaries.
nora: is this concentrated in the long preamble cases?
kevin: yes, concentrated on >4k prefix. suspect cumulative rounding in attention matrices for long seqlen after quant.
sasha: policy check: auto-fallback currently: slice parity delta <= -5% OR hallucination >=2% abs -> immediate rollback. that'll flip this.
julia: recommend temp policy tweak: for traffic <2% convert auto-rollback to alert-only for hallucination, and require parity delta <= -10% for auto-rollback. For parity deltas between -5% and -10% alert as high-priority and collect extra samples.
eng-oncall: agree. Pager only if global parity <= -8% or hallucination >=4.5% abs sustained 10m. Otherwise slack alerts.
nora: operational plan: drop to 0.5% canary observe 60m, disable auto-fallback for hallucination, enable shadow sampling at 6% for legal-doc and long-doc slices. run extended kv warmup with 2k-10k seqs.
kevin: I'll run kernel trace comparing fused vs reference attention to see if accumulation differs. If kernel is root cause we can patch quickly. If not, try asymmetric quant scales on FFN/Proj.
sasha: I'll re-run tokenizer-agnostic byte-align diffs and a targeted eval that zeroes small logit noise (logits*0.99) to see sensitivity.
nora: config I will apply now:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v7-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 60m --auto-fallback "enabled=false" --notes "legal-doc parity capture"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v7-int4 --traffic 6% --mode sampling --slices legal-doc,long-doc
rwctl watch add --slice legal-doc --metrics parity_f1,hallucination --window 60m --sustain 30m
```
deploy-bot: [action] rollout created by nora: id rlt-1742103333. canary 0.5% observe=60m. auto-fallback disabled for hallucination. shadow sampling 6% enabled. report path s3://redwood-evals/1742103333/v7-int4/report.html
kevin: starting kv warmup + kernel trace now. ETA ~2h. posting intermediate logs to s3://redwood-traces/1742103333/kernel/
julia: I'll update the rollout-runbook to reflect temporary threshold changes and add a note: "low-traffic canaries should not auto-rollback on hallucination spikes; require manual triage unless traffic >=2% or parity delta severe."
eng-oncall: copied. will escalate if pager thresholds hit.
nora: thanks team. keep updates minimal and only post new telemetry or requests. reconvene 03:10 UTC or earlier if rollback triggered.
